info.title: Frontmost AI API
info.description: Read how AI apps answer your buyers' questions, and change the questions Frontmost AI asks.

remaining.description: Credits left now: the monthly credits and top-ups, less what running work holds

monthly_remaining.description: The part of `remaining` that ends at `cycle_resets_at`

topup_remaining.description: The part of `remaining` from top-ups, which last 12 months

projected_monthly_use.description: Credits used this cycle plus what the project schedules use before the reset

ask_last_30_days.description: Credits Ask used in the last 30 days. Not in `projected_monthly_use`

status.description: low: 80% of this cycle's credits are used. out: fewer than 10 left, so no scan can start

threshold_credits.description: When remaining falls below this, auto top-up buys credits. Null until a person sets it

refill_to_credits.description: Auto top-up buys packs of 1,000 until remaining is back at this. Null until a person sets it

auto_topup.description: Change it on the Billing page

credits.description: Null for a person who sees only some of the workspace's projects

apps.description: The AI apps each scan asks, such as chatgpt and gemini

cadence.description: How often the scans run. mwf is Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. weekly is Monday

weekly_brief.description: Write a brief after each Monday scan

RunConfigChange.description: The fields to set. A field left out keeps its value. On a new project, it takes the default: the workspace's `apps`, the workspace's `scan_cadence`, and `weekly_brief` true

rates.description: The credits one answer uses in each AI app, at today's rate

minimum_per_scan.description: The fewest credits a scan uses

per_scan.description: max(active_questions × the sum of the rates, minimum_per_scan)

scans_per_month.description: Scans in the longest month: daily 31, mwf 14, weekly 5, off 0

briefs_per_month.description: Briefs in the longest month: 5 Mondays when weekly_brief is on and the scans run, else 0

monthly_max.description: per_scan × scans_per_month + per_brief × briefs_per_month. The most credits a calendar month uses. Ask is billed per message and is not in it

RunCost.description: The credits the run config uses. Every number in monthly_max is here

apps.description: The AI apps each scan asks

cadence.description: How often the scans run. mwf is Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. weekly is Monday

weekly_brief.description: Whether a brief is written after each Monday scan

active_questions.description: Questions each scan asks. Change them with the questions routes

RunConfig.description: What the project's scans ask, how often they run, and the credits that uses. Change it with PATCH /projects/{id}

at.description: When the next scheduled scan delivers. Null when none is scheduled

off.description: Why no scan is scheduled. daily: the project's cadence is off. plan: the plan has no scans now

apps.description: Older field. The same as run_config.apps

scanning.description: Older field. True when run_config.cadence is not off

cadence.description: Older field. The same as run_config.cadence

weekly_brief.description: Older field. The same as run_config.weekly_brief

is_branded.description: Null while Frontmost AI has not decided whether the question names the brand

status.description: partial: some answers failed, and the scan counts the answers it has

run_config.description: The run_config you sent. Nothing keeps it between calls

ProjectSetup.description: The site read is still running. Send `next` after `retry_after` seconds.

value.description: numerator / denominator, from 0 to 1. Null with no answers

previous.description: The same rate in the comparison period. Null with no comparison

Rate.description: A rate with its counts, such as 8 of 36 answers

Position.description: The average first-mention place over `answers` answers with a known place. 1 is first

sentiment.description: Positive statements over classified statements. Null before Sentiment existed

definitions_version.description: Changes when a counting rule changes

sentiment.description: Positive statements over classified statements. Null before Sentiment existed

message.description: Why scope and totals are null

named_instead_of_you.description: Answers that named this rival and not you

named_you.description: Answers that cited this site and named you

named.description: Whether the answer named you. Null unless status is ok

AnswerSummary.description: One answer without its text. Get the answer to read it

mentions.description: Each business once, in order of first mention

result.description: After it is marked done: whether the site names you now

is_branded.description: Null while Frontmost AI has not decided whether the question names the brand

created.description: False when the project already had this question
